content:
sanjay: FYI after we reduced EU edge keepalive, we see a reconnect spike and per-tenant tokens doubled for some customers. Suspect resumed streams counted as new.

kevin: console alerted around 07:12UTC. noisy and confusing.

nina: proxy logs show last_event_id present but resume_id missing in several entries:
```
[proxy-eu-03] 2026-03-22T07:12:05Z INFO resume: tenant=acme org_id=42 client_ip=10.1.2.3 last_event_id=5689 resume_id=
[proxy-eu-03] 2026-03-22T07:12:05Z INFO new_conn: tenant=acme org_id=42 client_ip=10.1.2.3
```

sanjay: if resume_id is empty billing treats it as a new stream -> double charge. Edge probe might be causing sticky routing to drop headers.

maggie: can we flip the keepalive change? we should avoid customer impact.

nina: short-term: add telemetry tag `stream.resume=true` when last_event_id present; console can then dedupe. longer term fix proxy to preserve resume_id.

kevin: console change: add dimension stream.resume and show resume/fresh breakdown in token graph. ops need to tell them apart.

sanjay: patch idea (defensive): if last_event_id && !resume_id -> mark as resume for billing. beware proxies that strip headers.

maggie: privacy: don't include raw client IP in telemetry. use a salted hash of tenant+last_event_id+short_ip.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy.redwood.internal/d/preview/edge-keepalive-rollback-2026-03-22 (ci passed)

alex: oncall can mute the billing alert for 30m during canary but need rollback plan if dedupe doesn't help.

kevin: after telemetry we should add query-level dedupe: ignore duplicate connections within 3s for same tenant+resume_key.

sanjay: noted. if >5 tenants affected or >$X delta we'll file a postmortem.

maggie: I'll run canary (5% EU) and annotate console. will roll back immediately on unexplained spikes.

kevin: :thumbsup:
